title: ormiscus pusillus
intro: Ormiscus pusillus, commonly known as the 'Lesser Club Moss', is a type of ancient, non-vascular plant that belongs to the Lycopodiophyta class. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ormiscus pusillus include its ability to calm and soothe the respiratory tract, making it a potential remedy for conditions such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lycopene, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
